notes.title: Version 1.086
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed how Amity was going down by way too much when it came to not replying to dialogue.
[*] Redid how the game determines if a staff member can see a student. This was done to fix a glitch.
[*] Finally fixed the mistake where some NPCs could sometimes chat while out-of-bounds.
[*] Added 3 Hoodie options.
[*] Added 1 Face Extra A option.
[*] Added another customization camera angle.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.085 - Minor Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Adjusted some of the math formulas for how Amity is altered when it comes to replying since there was some pretty big mistakes. In some cases, Amity was being increased/decreased by too little, and in some extreme cases by way too much.
[*] Adjusted how characters can react to egotist dialogue.
[*] Reduced the title logo size.
[*] Reduced the size of the text found in the How to Play a tiny bit.
[*] A few extremely minor coding changes.
[/list]
